title: MCP Service
desc: Publish and manage blog content directly from AI clients via the MCP protocol

access.title: Access info
access.capabilities: Available capabilities: create / update / publish / unpublish / delete articles (Markdown), upload images to the media library, and query categories and tags — 9 tools in total.
access.security: Security limits: each key is rate-limited to 120 requests per minute; deleting an article requires explicit AI confirmation; the key secret is shown only once at creation.

empty.title: No API keys yet — connect in three steps:
empty.step1: Click "Create Key" to generate a key
empty.step2: Copy the MCP config to your AI client
empty.step3: Ask it to publish an article in your AI client
